description: This PHP source file defines the 'CorporateDirectoryModuleController' class, extending 'AbstractVueController'. It manages the retrieval of job titles and locations through dedicated services, configuring a Vue component for the corporate directory module's frontend.

classes.name: CorporateDirectoryModuleController
classes.description: Controller class managing the corporate directory module, responsible for preparing Vue component with job titles and locations for rendering.

methods.name: getJobTitleService
methods.description: Lazily initializes and returns the JobTitleService instance used to fetch job title data.

methods.name: getLocationService
methods.description: Lazily initializes and returns the LocationService instance used to fetch location data.

methods.name: preRender
methods.description: Prepares the Vue component by fetching job titles and locations, then setting the component for rendering.
